pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, multi-pointed dark brown regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients. Patches on the flank exhibit a stellate or jagged geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the patches. The network features clear junction nodes where three to four corridors intersect, with narrow but consistent pixel thickness.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck, created by a short, upright mane against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant foreground occlusion by out-of-focus, light-green herbaceous vegetation, which obscures the ventral line and creates a soft-focus overlay on the lower flank and upper neck.
